pool.text: The city was founded when this territory was still part of North Carolina.
Nashville was incorporated as a city and became the county seat.
The city was named as the permanent capital of the state.
Nashville became the first state capital in the Confederacy taken by Union forces.
Queen Victoria reportedly called Nashville a musical city after hearing performers.
Southern confections including Goo Goo Clusters have been made here since then.
Announcer David Cobb first broadcasted the nickname Music City, U.S.A.
Nashville's first skyscraper, the Life and Casualty Tower, was completed downtown.
Nashville consolidated its government with Davidson County, forming a metropolitan government.
The city of Nashville and Davidson County officially merged.
The Nashville Sounds baseball team was established as an expansion franchise.
Intercity rail service ended with the cancellation of service to Union Station.
Nashville has been the headquarters of guitar company Gibson since this year.
The city was the site of a pivotal garage door industry moment.
Nashville was awarded a National Hockey League expansion team named Predators.
The Tennessee Titans football franchise officially moved to Nashville.
The NFL team changed its franchise name from Tennessee Oilers to Titans.
Nissan North America moved its corporate headquarters to a southern suburb.
Much of Nashville was extensively flooded as part of a series of regional floods.
A vehicle exploded on Second Avenue, killing the perpetrator and injuring eight others.
